title: Translation lookup falls back and never crashes production

statements.text: t resolves a key from the current language, then the fallback (English) data, then the explicit fallback argument; if all are missing it returns an empty string with a warning in production and throws outside production

evidence.excerpt: const t(path: NestedKeyOf<typeof fallbackLangData>, replacement?: { [key: string]: string | number } | null, fallback?: string)

statements.text: If a locale file fails to load, setLanguage uses fallbackLangData instead of rejecting

notes: Imported from coding-agent output on 2026-11-02; citations verified by Autoforge. Rationale: A missing translation or a locale that fails to load must not crash the editor for end users.
